source.ref: Karnataka Municipal Corporations Act / Karnataka Municipalities Act 1964 — surcharge on stamp duty for local bodies
source.quoted_text: Widely and consistently reported (ClearTax, Godrej Capital, NoBroker, Homefirst, 2024-26): in addition to the 10% s.3B cess, a LOCAL-BODY SURCHARGE on the stamp duty applies — approximately 2% of the stamp duty in urban/BBMP areas and 3% in rural areas. Levied under the Karnataka municipal/panchayat framework (Karnataka Municipalities Act 1964 and the Municipal Corporations Act). Reconciliation: 5% stamp + 0.5% cess (10% of 5%) + 0.1% surcharge (2% of 5%) = 5.6% — the universally-quoted Bangalore effective rate.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM (secondary sources, but strongly corroborated across many and it reconciles exactly to the cited 5.6% Bangalore total) — PENDING the primary municipal-law provision/section number. 2% of stamp duty (urban/BBMP, default) or 3% (rural) — fact ka_area='rural' for rural/panchayat, else urban. Computed on the base stamp duty (not compounded with the s.3B cess). NOTE the rural>urban direction is counterintuitive but consistently reported. Attached to conveyance; extend to other s.3B-cess instruments (gift etc.) once confirmed.
